reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents Forsage as a business opportunity, directs viewers to register, and describes paying 0.05 ETH plus additional fees for positions funded by inviting partners. It recommends a multi-position start and projects returns of 1430 ETH within 12 weeks, with X3 and X4 return tables. These are promoted payment and return claims, though the available video evidence does not establish that the figures were achieved, transactions occurred, or returns were guaranteed.

citations.quote: Forced marketing has a matrix strategy
When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet.
Usually, when you invite your partners, they will take the positions below you.

opening.argument: Judge the earnings figures as a conditional calculation, not a promise of what a viewer will receive. The speaker introduces the projection with an example and makes its result depend on continued progress through positions. The explanation also acknowledges that an indirect registration can change who gets a placement. Those qualifications matter: the material presents a possible path through the system, but the cited passages do not establish that any viewer achieved the projected total or was guaranteed to do so.

citations.quote: Now let's calculate how you can increase your tickets. For example, in the first week you have broken a level position cycle.
If you will move like that with a position on Saturday, then in 12 weeks you will move to the 12th position
In case of an indirect registration, there is a chance to beat other partners

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies a fee reaching someone's wallet when a partner occupies a spot. That describes the proposed payment rule; it does not show an actual transaction or establish the projected 12-week outcome. Likewise, saying invited partners usually take positions below you is qualified language, not proof that every invitation produces income. The earnings calculation is explicitly introduced as an example.

citations.quote: When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet.
Usually, when you invite your partners, they will take the positions below you.
For example, in the first week you have broken a level position cycle.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional wording does not turn this into detached market commentary. The speaker recommends starting with paid positions, describes fees arriving when partners occupy spots, and projects a large total from repeated position cycles. The defense's quotes show that the projection depends on participation; they do not erase the video's invitation to participate in a recruitment-funded matrix.

citations.quote: The general recommendation for the majority is to start directly with three positions in both programs at the same time.
When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet.
a total of 1430 ET.

opening.argument: Much of this presentation teaches the structure of the two programs. It defines the matrix, explains the number of positions, and walks through when a position closes and reopens. The diagrams likewise depict positions and their relationships. A careful reading can treat the material as an operational demonstration: explaining how a mechanism is supposed to work is distinct from showing that its earnings claims came true.

citations.quote: So, how does the forced marketing work? Forced marketing has a matrix strategy
individually, in each program you can find twelve positions. All are identical and work in the same way.
The reinvestment process is automatically performed as soon as the last free position is completed. the current position closes and the process repeats.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening quotes the matrix rule and partner placement, but those are precisely the mechanics an explanation of this system would need to cover. Neither quote, by itself, demonstrates that a placement or wallet payment occurred. The stated registration cost supplies another operational detail; describing a cost is not proof that the illustrated returns were realized.

citations.quote: Forced marketing has a matrix strategy
Usually, when you invite your partners, they will take the positions below you.
So to get a record in Forsage you need 0.05 ETH.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An instructional format does not make the instruction neutral. The description offers registration links, while the narration recommends buying multiple positions and tells viewers how partner placements produce wallet payments. The defense correctly notes that realized returns are unverified, but realized returns are not needed to recognize the promoted pay-to-enter matrix.

citations.quote: If you wish to engage in the Forsage TRON or Ethereum business, below are the links with which you can register!
The general recommendation for the majority is to start directly with three positions in both programs at the same time.
When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet.

opening.argument: The cited evidence describes purchasing defined positions, including a stated entry price and separately purchased later positions. It also distinguishes paid upgrades from automatic reinvestment that, according to the speaker, requires no new deposit. Those details support reading the video as a presentation of priced participation in a business system. The supplied material does not establish that anyone was asked for credentials, that a payment was taken in this video, or that a particular viewer received the forecast income.

citations.quote: The first position of each program costs 0.025 Ethereum, but cannot be compared separately. They are bought together for recording. So to get a record in Forsage you need 0.05 ETH.
And, further, you can purchase all the other separate deposits. In order from the smallest to the largest.
Partners will buy only upgrades, and the reinvestment is made automatically, because you don't need a deposit.

rebuttal.rebuttal: A matrix and a price do not, in isolation, establish that the video records a completed scam. The reference opening's wallet-payment quote is phrased as what will happen when a partner takes a spot, while its invitation quote says where partners usually go. Neither supplies an observed payment or an independently verified return. The narrower conclusion is that the speaker describes the rules of a paid referral arrangement.

citations.quote: When the first partner occupies the first spot under you, 100% of the fee will be credited into your personal wallet.
Usually, when you invite your partners, they will take the positions below you.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing credential request and unobserved transactions do not address the mechanism actually presented. Entry requires ETH; invited partners take positions below existing participants; and the speaker says their fees reach the participant's wallet. Registration links and a recommendation to start with three positions make this a promotion of that mechanism, not merely a price list for an ordinary service.
